scope: Dimensional consistency only; assumes density labels in binary gigabits; not a compatibility test or observation of fitted CMP packages

attachment_issue.text: | 0x0C | 4 Gb/die × 8 dies = 4 GB (4-Hi) | CMP100 / P100 / V100 16GB |
attachment_issue.finding: The stated eight memory dies are inconsistent with its own 4-Hi height label. Four GiB by itself is compatible with 4x8-Gib or 8x4-Gib geometry.

limits: NVIDIA gives general HBM2 heights/die densities and initial P100 4-Hi configuration; this does not establish GP100 support for 8GiB/stack, nor physical density/height on CMP.
